title: Long-term Strategy to Ensure Sufficient and Resilient Housing for Foreign Workers
what_it_is: Long-term Strategy to Ensure Sufficient and Resilient Housing for Foreign Workers

sections.label: Foreign worker dormitory bed supply
sections.summary: The Ministry outlines measures to expand dormitory bed supply, including new purpose-built dormitories and streamlined applications, while urging employers to reduce reliance on migrant workers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Manpower in light of the high occupancy rates and recent closures of purpose-built dormitories, what is the Ministry's long-term strategy to ensure sufficient and resilient housing for foreign workers.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: This includes extending the leases of expiring dormitories where feasible, as well as enabling existing purpose-built dormitories (PBDs) with excess space to increase their occupancy load, while meeting prevailing dormitory housing standards.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: We have also been streamlining and facilitating applications for new Factory-Converted Dormitories and temporary workers' quarters, such as Temporary Occupation Licence Quarters to provide more sources of bed supply.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Over the next few years, six new PBDs with around 45,000 beds will also be added to the market, including the Ministry of Manpower's 2,400-bed PBD in Jalan Tukang, set to be operational in early 2026.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: While the Government has put in place measures to expand dormitory bed supply, this will not be sustainable if demand for work permit holders grows unabatedly.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: So, we urge employers to adopt productivity measures to reduce their reliance on migrant workers.

sections.label: Phased dormitory transition plan
sections.summary: The dormitory transition plan stages existing dormitories to new standards in phases, considering peak worker numbers and available bed spaces to avoid supply shortages.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: Briefly, the dormitory transition plan is a phased approach.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: We take into account the peak numbers of workers at any point in time as well as the existing available number of bed spaces, so that we stage the transition of existing dormitories to new standards in a phased manner, to make sure that as we take the transition of existing dormitories, we do not end up causing a supply shortage.

sections.label: Dormitory Association industry matching
sections.summary: The Ministry keeps close contact with the Dormitory Association of Singapore, which helps match employers needing bed spaces to dormitories with excess spaces, with prices expected to stabilise.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: We keep in close contact with the Dormitory Association of Singapore Limited, so that we hear the industry's voice constantly.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: They are also helping us connect employers who may need bed spaces for their workers to those dormitories that have excess spaces, so there is a matching effort that takes place at the industry level.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: Over time, as the supply and demand balance is achieved, we will see dormitory prices stabilising.
